message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"Current best numerical quality is at coef_frac=15 (SQNR ~85 dB) but area is high (8520 um^2 for symmetric_preadd). Decreasing precision to coef_frac=14 offers a large area reduction (8552 um^2 for symmetric_preadd, similar) while SQNR drops only ~6.4 dB to ~78.7 dB, which is still a good balance. The action has legal unvisited neighbors, enabling exploration of the precision-area tradeoff."}
